steps.title: Feed the starter
steps.instruction: At least 12 hours before baking, ideally the day before, take the starter from the fridge and mix 20 g of it with 40 g of each flour and slightly warm water. Mix thoroughly. After 12 hours or better overnight it should have doubled in volume.

steps.title: Mix the dough
steps.instruction: Butter or oil the mixer bowl. Add 500 g of wheat flour, 360 g of slightly warm water, and 11 g of salt. Mix 3 minutes on speed 1, then 6 minutes on speed 2. Rest 5 minutes, then mix another 2 to 3 minutes on speed 1 if the dough is still too sticky.

steps.title: Shape and chill
steps.instruction: Form the dough into a ball in the bowl and refrigerate overnight.

steps.title: Prep the Roman pot
steps.instruction: The next morning, soak the Roman pot's lid and base in water for 15 to 20 minutes. Wipe it dry enough that no puddles remain, then dust with semolina to keep the bread from sticking.

steps.title: Bake covered
steps.instruction: Add the dough to the pot and bake at 230 degrees C on the lowest oven rack for 45 minutes. Importantly, the pot is going into a cold oven and warming up together with the oven.

steps.title: Bake uncovered
steps.instruction: Remove the lid and continue baking for another 15 to 20 minutes, until the crust turns golden.

steps.title: Rest and cool
steps.instruction: Let the bread rest in the pot for 10 to 15 minutes, then at least 30 minutes out of it before slicing.
